GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began well. Pushed fwd 3 Wide until worked to lead on rail by 2 Lengths @ 800m. Held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide (2L clear) on home turn. Pressured & laid in 3 Wide @ 200m & held on in last 100m. # Led - held on.

Bit Slow Out .5l Went Forward Four Wide Settled Down Outside Leader 3 Wide .5 Lengths 1000m 3 Wide 3rd 1 Lengths 600m 3 Wide 5th 3 Lengths home turn Six Wide Under Pressure 8th weakened badly Straight # wide/tired 300m

Debut for stable. Slow Out . Pushed to recover & raced keenly Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead) early . Stayed same until held up @ rear on inside @ 450m. Held up on home turn. (6l from lead). Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & held ground on inside in last 200m. # Margin unfair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Near the 1000m, when the tempo of the race reduced, improved onto heels had to be checked and got its head up. Continued to race keenly through the middle stages. Was held up for clear running rounding the home turn and was unable to be fully tested until approaching the 250m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. battled away. slow out # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length off, under pressure turn and dropped out # breeze/gone turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 100m was momentarily steadied off heels. Rdr reported his mount travelled comfortably outside the lead through the early and middle stages. He said his mnt failed to respond to his riding in the straight and was disappointing  in its finishing effort. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Went Forward and sat Outside Leader but had to do some work .5 Lengths 800m, Under Pressure Straightening Up and weakened in Straight , Vet revealed no abnormalities # worked too hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide in the early stages before being allowed to stride forward to sit outside the leader, near the 800m. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs. Co-tnr reported that the gelding had pulled up well and could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance other than that may have come to the end of its preparation and had been sent for a spell. Must trial. Since trialled on 2 occasions at Rosehill 17/3/26 and 24/4/26.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze 1.5L off, niggled a touch turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, only battled on one pace to the line # had chance
Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down 2 Lengths Clear allowed to dictate terms same To The Turn Under Pressure 300 Collared x 125m and # run ended 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated the gelding travelled satisfactorily in the lead through the early and middle stages, however it failed to respond to his efforts when placed under pressure in the straight. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Straight To The Front by 1l. steadied midrace, 0.5l Clear . Ridden Along to Turn and cornered 2 Lengths Clear . Ran On Strongly and full of running to win well ( steadied bit 1st time ) # led/smart debut win
